### **IMPORTANTE**
Es obligatorio revisar [el reglamento de la WCA.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) para comprender las normas y procedimientos que se realizaran en el torneo.

* Revisar la pestaña [Registro](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PlazaCenterCubeI2023#32648-registro-register) para conocer los medios de pago.
* Revisar la pestaña [Horario](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PlazaCenterCubeI2023#competition-schedule) para conocer el cronograma del torneo.
* Para **Registrarte** al torneo hacer click en [Registrarse](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PlazaCenterCubeI2023/register)
 
### **IMPORTANT**
  You must check [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to understand the rules and procedures to be followed during the tournament.
	
*  Check [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PlazaCenterCubeI2023#32648-registro-register) to know the payment methods.
*  Check [Schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PlazaCenterCubeI2023#competition-schedule) to know the cronogram.
*   To **Register** to the competition click [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PlazaCenterCubeI2023/register)
